source_text: Voluntary medical male circumcision (VMMC) programs, rolled out since 2007 in high-HIV-prevalence countries like Kenya, Eswatini, and South Africa under WHO guidance, emphasize adolescent assent alongside parental consent to affirm voluntariness, targeting boys aged 10-15 for HIV risk reduction of approximately 60%. [124]
